newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 20.085 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 20.085 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate for Thursday was fixed at 20.0850 percent, or a rise of 31.00 basis points from 19.7750 percent, the rate for July 30, Banco de Mexico said on Wednesday.

The 28-day TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is revised each working day, and is valid for the day after it is set. The new rate will be published in Thursday's edition of the Mexican government's Official Gazette.
The weekly revised 91-day TIIE rate fell 8.00 basis points to 20.40 percent on Wednesday from 20.4800 percent the week before.
The 28-day TIIP rate, also revised weekly, meanwhile rose 19.38 basis points to 20.0394 percent on Wednesday from 19.8456 percent the week before.
The TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is replacing the TIIP, an average interbank rate.
